title: LLS platform event v1 (HUB ⇄ SLEE)
description: Canonical event contract shared by LLS HUB (PHP), the SLEE Worker (TypeScript), and future Worker apps. SLEE also accepts HUB's native lls_hub_eme_emit() shape and normalizes it (case-insensitive keys, aliases).

event_id.description: Idempotency key (UUID). Re-sends with the same id are ignored.

type.description: Dotted event name. Legacy aliases accepted: sah_quiz, glotype, power_move_optin, freedom_tax, datebase, lls_hub_optin, ailife_coach.

attributes.description: Normalized HUB attributes (case-insensitive). Merged additively — empty values never overwrite.

identify_qs.description: Query string from lls_hub_generate_identify_url(); appended to every email CTA. Added automatically by the WP bridge.

x-auth: Headers X-LLS-Timestamp (unix seconds) + X-LLS-Signature: sha256=hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + '.' + rawBody)); 300s replay window.
